name: Boys & Girls Club of Garden Grove
notes: Confirmed food-pantry site (distributes produce, dairy, dry/canned goods, meat, fish, frozen), but no credible source gives a specific recurring distribution day+time. Building/campus hours (Mon-Fri 7 AM-6 PM at 10540 Chapman) are facility hours, not pantry distribution hours. Call (714) 530-0430 to confirm.

name: Bracken's Kitchen Inc.
notes: Mobile food-rescue / community feeding org, not a fixed public pantry. Community Feeding Program page lists partner sites but no public recurring day+time schedule. Office hours Mon-Fri 9-4:30 are not distribution hours.

name: Calvary Chapel WestGrove/Shining Light
notes: Calvary Chapel Westgrove 'Bread of Life' food pantry is open Thu & Fri 3:00-4:30 PM (photo ID required, any city). Confirmed by two directories (foodpantries.org and feedam.org/resource/200620). Separately, the 'Shining Light' ministry serves a MONTHLY hot meal on Mondays (~6-8:30 PM at Atlantis/Garden Grove Park) - not a specific weekly pantry, so schedule above reflects the Bread of Life pantry.

name: Food for Fellowship
notes: Operates out of the same address as Calvary Chapel Westgrove (12832 Knott St) but no independently sourced specific recurring distribution day+time was found for this org.

name: Garden Grove Church of God
notes: Listed as a food-distribution/donation recipient in Garden Grove city list, but no credible source gives a specific recurring day+time. Call (714) 894-4060 to confirm.

name: Garden Grove Samoan Assembly of God Church
notes: Only vague info found ('certain Fridays or Saturdays each month, starts ~5am until food runs out') - no specific recurring day, so marked not found per rules.

name: International Bhiksu Buddist Association (I.B.B.A.)
notes: Listed as distributing non-perishables in Garden Grove but no specific recurring distribution day+time found.

name: Korean American Federation of O.C
notes: No specific pantry schedule found for the Federation itself. (A separate 'Korean American Seniors Association' pantry - different org/address - lists last Wednesday 10 AM-12 PM, but that does not apply to this site.)

name: Nhan Hoa Health Center
notes: Federally qualified health center; no specific food-distribution/pantry day+time found in credible sources.

name: Padres Unidos
notes: Nonprofit focused on education/family programs; org website shows no food pantry schedule and no credible source gives a specific recurring distribution day+time.
